entries.title: R1. Review target and changes
entries.finding: The original targets eccddcc. Current application source is cefc979, three commits later, adding Daily History/saves, assurance and evidence work, and portrait navigation fixes. All 22 referenced historical Git file objects exist; 11 changed and 11 are byte-identical.
entries.action: Use the original for historical claims and this dated register for current evidence.

entries.title: R2. Core product and calculation baseline
entries.finding: The product separates calculated astronomical facts from generated reflective prose. Its calculation baseline and uncertainty/fallback handling remain documented. Mechanical checks and interpretation traceability do not establish scientific validity of the interpretations.
entries.action: Keep product/spec descriptions separate from current deployment and provider evidence.

entries.title: R3. Current production configuration
entries.finding: The live Worker uses Daily hybrid/Codex, Pattern Codex and Sol/xhigh. Daily/writer prompts are 1.0.3, planner 1.0.1 and verifier 1.0.0-verifier. Geoapify and both portrait flags are enabled; the ontology pipeline is off. PATTERN_GENERATION_ENABLED is now present and enabled.
entries.action: Bind configuration to the observed build/version and check runner installation separately.

entries.title: R4. Text prompt policies
entries.finding: Current text source uses isolated app-server JSON. The installed service bundle still uses codex exec for ordinary text. CLI 0.153.3 and ChatGPT login were observed; account category, training, sharing and retention remain unverified.
entries.action: Activate the reviewed candidate through the existing rollout process, prove dedicated-account publication, and obtain account-owner evidence.

entries.title: R5. Daily validation and safety rules
entries.finding: The pooled-vocabulary finding was valid at the original target. Current policy 1.1.1 checks sentence-level claim support against each paragraph’s cited facts. These are bounded English checks, not arbitrary semantic entailment. Fresh Daily generation accepted 5/6 samples; one unknown fact ID was correctly rejected.
entries.action: Retain citation enforcement and investigate reference-ID generation/correction. Keep editorial assessment separate from mechanical validation.

entries.title: R6. Ontology admission has two assurance levels
entries.finding: The two ontology release-assurance paths remain distinct. Newly generated documents from both use common publication safety checks and a model semantic verifier. D1 points to pattern-ontology-en-us-internal-0.1.0, with no matching machine-pipeline evidence run.
entries.action: Describe release assurance separately from per-document validation and retain corpus provenance limitations.

entries.title: R7. Actual interpretation corpus and rights classification
entries.finding: The corpus remains 60 model-generated first-party fragments. licensed_excerpt is a rights flag, not human authorship or independent source authority. Integrity is consistent, while signed passing review coverage is 0/60 and historical provider/model/account/date remain unknown.
entries.action: Have the named independent human review all five criteria for every fragment and supply attributable evidence. Do not backfill historical unknowns from today’s runner.

entries.title: R8. Source-aware Pattern regeneration
entries.finding: Eligibility uses a curated source fingerprint. The prior Pattern remains readable during replacement or failure; successful atomic replacement erases its generation material with later physical cleanup. This is not Pattern version history. Daily History and saves were added separately.
entries.action: Verify source alignment and replacement behavior in the designated account; describe Daily History separately.

entries.title: R9. Geocoder rollout and failure containment
entries.finding: Geoapify mapping still accepts verified OSM-backed results with manual redirect handling. Credential failure is contained to place operations; the per-user limiter is not an account quota. Live health/configuration return 200 and the protected reading route returns 401 without authentication. Authenticated geocoding was not exercised.
entries.action: Configure the dedicated-account canary and actual account-wide credit observation. Threshold evaluation is ready; collection, scheduling and alert delivery are not configured.

entries.title: R10. Native image-generation boundary
entries.finding: The native image boundary pins CLI 0.153.3, checks isolation/media identity, and cleans bounded image artifacts. Provenance distinguishes the requested model label from an observed identifier: unexposed identity is null/not_exposed; older records are legacy_unrecorded. Local cleanup is not upstream deletion.
entries.action: Preserve requested/observed provenance and obtain actual account-owner data-use and retention evidence.

entries.title: R11. Image-to-3D geometry and audit boundary
entries.finding: The full current API service was read locally. Geometry remains declarative, compiled by trusted code and evaluated in a separate same-model visual pass. Program/part/triangle/GLB limits and consent/source/ownership fences remain. Same-model checking is not independent human review.
entries.action: Exercise saved-asset reuse and late-upload fences with the designated test account and retain hashes rather than private media.

entries.title: R12. Portrait consent, reader experience and export
entries.finding: Chart-specific opt-in, four-chapter admission, complete reading fallback, asset reuse and withdrawal fences are implemented. The archive includes the full reading, images, GLBs and source/program/audit records, without an offline viewer; account export is separate. Navigation/layout received subsequent fixes.
entries.action: Verify full prose, reuse, withdrawal during work, deletion and cleanup on the designated account. Aggregate D1 counts do not close that lifecycle.

entries.title: R13. Recorded tests and real-provider probes
entries.finding: The final tools passed six fresh-chain and seven operational-canary regressions. Independent code review found and closed reporting/privacy issues. The aggregate receipt binds source hashes and built artifacts when complete. Earlier totals in the original register remain historical.
entries.action: Use only the completed final gate receipt for this candidate. Keep CI, model-sample outcomes and production evidence distinct.

entries.title: R14. Migration and deployment evidence
entries.finding: Worker version 52a5c8df-3b67-499b-951e-0586a604c89f serves 100% and its successful build maps to cefc979. Migrations through 0028 are recorded. Two enabled portrait grants, one ready portrait and four complete mesh jobs exist; completions predate this Worker. The installed runner differs from the current candidate.
entries.action: Keep Worker, database, installed runner and authenticated lifecycle evidence separate. Verify activation and fresh durable publication.

entries.title: R15. CI and model-evaluation limits
entries.finding: Twenty new fictional outputs were observed: six Daily, five Pattern stage and nine verifier outputs, with zero transport failures. All three evaluation runs have passed:false. Positive-control adjudication and a reproduced deterministic negation false positive remain open. No durable production generation or independent human editorial review was established.
entries.action: Adjudicate the control, address bounded quality issues, and rerun frozen samples. Bind policies/source hashes, Worker, runner and migrations; retain all failures.
